GAPS: (1) No SP timeline export — cuttingStartedAt/runner/secured timestamps live on each SP but no flattened CSV export. finding: IST PSC Bauer connects to sim dept sim-surfside-ttx-2 from FEMA IST device. Anonymous auth: Bauer's session authenticates as a different anonymous uid than the local PSC #3 session. Database rules (v3.7.0 + v3.8.2 refinements) allow read/write to any /departments/{deptId}/ subtree if auth != null AND the uid is in the dept's /members list — OR if auth != null without any member check. Current rules grant ALL anonymous users full access to ALL departments — no /members enforcement. In practice for IST integration: Bauer reads + writes the dept just like Doyle (PSC #2). She sees the same SPs, same org chart, same inventory. The app does NOT distinguish IST member from local PSC. There is no "permission" or "scope" or "tenant" concept. Confirmed v4.0.0 Phase 3B gap: per-device UID + role-based security rules required. Without it: any anonymous-auth user on the public app could write to this dept. Workaround: keep the dept name + ID secret. Not viable for production multi-agency ops.
